title: Do Retail Trades Move Markets?
one_line: Retail order imbalances (TAQ small trades, 1983-2001) persist for weeks and move prices in the same direction short-term; stocks heavily bought by retail underperform over the next year.

findings.statement: Weekly imbalance predicts next-week returns positively; annual horizon negatively (≈ −4.4%/yr spread).

why.pattern: Correlated retail demand creates temporary price pressure.

reported_results.headline: Retail order imbalances (TAQ small trades, 1983-2001) persist for weeks and move prices in the same direction short-term; stocks heavily bought by retail underperform over the next year.
